cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Back My Version
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to remember, repeat, and defend one shared version of events when questions begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The allotment committee's asking about the greenhouse. We arrived after the glass broke, remember? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saw your wheelbarrow hit it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. We came inside afterwards. Can we both tell them we were clearing up?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll say that. I won't lie about the wheelbarrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then start with clearing up. If they ask about the barrow, we moved it away afterwards. Let's both use that order.
